summary: Validated the admin-approved password reset feature (no email dependency). Backend: 14/14 pytest cases PASSED in test_iter42_reset_flow.py — enumeration-safe generic message, DB has identity_match + masked hint and no raw identifier/temp_password/token, admin list, non-admin 403 on /api/admin/reset-requests (list/approve/reject/audit-logs), approve requires identity_verified (400) then returns 12-char temp password with letters+digits, token_version bump invalidates old sessions (401 on /auth/me), old password 401, re-approve 409, admin cannot approve own request (403), temp-password login sets must_change_password + 403 gating on /users and /announcements while /auth/me still allowed, change-password rejects short pw (422), non-digit (400), wrong current (400), success + temp reuse 401, audit log contains reset_requested/reset_approved/password_changed, reject flow + duplicate reject 409 + reject_reason persisted, forgot-password rate-limit returns 429, super_admin regression. Frontend (Playwright): /forgot-password submit shows forgot-success-message; admin sidebar has 'Permintaan Reset' and 5 tabs render (pending/approved/rejected/all/audit); full approve UX works — reset-approve-{id} modal (reset-verify-method-input + reset-verify-checkbox + reset-approve-submit) returns a 12-char temp-password-value in temp-password-modal; siswa login with temp pw auto-redirects to /change-password; navigating to / stays on /change-password (gating); change-password form (change-current-input/change-new-input/change-confirm-input/change-submit-button) succeeds and lands on dashboard with success toast; /reset-password route redirects to /forgot-password; regression /, /accounts, /feedback, /reports load without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is now 5209 lines — long-standing refactor backlog persists; the new PASSWORD RESET block (~L3082-3197) is cohesive and self-contained and could be the first slice to extract into backend/routes/password_reset.py.

forgot-password rate-limit uses db.password_reset_requests collection separate from db.reset_requests (good: audit requests keep history, throttle rows auto-expire by time window). Consider a TTL index on password_reset_requests.ts to prevent unbounded growth.
approve_reset re-reads req after status check — current ordering is correct (own-user check uses the pre-update doc, then find_one_and_update ensures atomic pending→approved transition). Good.
gen_temp_password uses secrets.choice over a 55-char alphabet × 12 chars (≈ 69 bits entropy) and guarantees letter+digit — adequate for 30-min expiry.
Audit log stores IP but no raw identifier/password/token — compliant with the requirement.

LoginIn / ChangePwIn / ForgotIn use Pydantic Field constraints — min_length violations surface as 422 (FastAPI default). This diverges from the request's stated '400 for policy violations'; backend policy error for 'no digit' or 'same as old' returns 400 as expected, but <8 chars is intercepted earlier as 422. Non-blocking but worth aligning if strict 400 contract is desired.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of flows (forgot → admin approve → temp-login gating → change-password → dashboard)

Rate-limit by IP (10/hour on forgot-password) is shared across tests from the runner — clear db.password_reset_requests before running similar tests.
